dct_description_sm: Data from plant surveys conducted in aquatic habitats of the boreal forest in the province of Quebec, Canada, between 2007 and 2012. The datasets include the list of identified plant taxa, survey data for both plots and transects, as well as environmental data for both plots and transects.
dct_title_s: Associated data for Janssen et al. 2025, Riparian vegetation variability in natural boreal forests: lessons for delineating riparian zones.
